purpose: Select the next falsifiable research candidate without opening another weak or falsely independent alpha.

search_record.source_priority: peer-reviewed papers, university working papers, institutional papers, and official exchange data documentation

candidates.name: LIQUID_LARGE_CAP_BTC_TO_ALT_LEAD_LAG
candidates.reason: Recent high-frequency evidence places the exploitable multi-minute delay mainly in illiquid small caps; liquid large caps adjust almost simultaneously and the effect largely disappears after one minute. That is incompatible with the fixed five-asset liquid universe and its measured execution budget.

candidates.name: LOW_VOLUME_SHORT_TERM_REVERSAL
candidates.reason: The reported premium is concentrated in small, volatile, low-activity pairs and is weak in value-weighted portfolios after costs. Selecting those names would deliberately import adverse-selection and capacity risk into a safety-constrained futures system.

candidates.name: TURN_OF_15_MINUTE_CANDLE
candidates.reason: The reported mean effect is about 0.58 bp in the turn minute. The platform's current public-L2 entry estimate alone is about 3.36 bp before the exit leg, so the effect has no credible taker execution margin and overlaps Alpha 011's periodic-flow family.

candidates.name: VOLATILITY_MANAGED_CROSS_SECTIONAL_MOMENTUM
candidates.reason: The family has useful crash-control evidence but overlaps failed Alpha 006 and Alpha 008. A defensible test requires the point-in-time, survivorship-free universe that is still accumulating.

candidates.name: MINUTE_CROSS_CRYPTO_PREDICTABILITY
candidates.reason: A primary working paper reports out-of-sample Binance futures profitability after transaction costs, but its adaptive-LASSO top-30 implementation requires point-in-time membership, minute data, order-level execution controls, and a modern post-2021 replication. The current five surviving names cannot reproduce the cross-section without severe selection bias.
activation_conditions: at least 180 sealed point-in-time universe days
publisher-bound minute futures data including delisted instruments
no parameter search on the locked forward interval

candidates.name: CROSS_SECTIONAL_PERPETUAL_BASIS_CATCHUP
candidates.reason: The dated-futures basis factor has the strongest primary evidence among the screened candidates, but no strong independent perpetual-futures replication was found. The test is therefore explicitly family trial 3 under Alpha 009/013, not a new independent alpha, and a historical pass can only authorize a prospective point-in-time protocol.

selection_guard: No result from the development interval was calculated before this screen and Alpha 014 preregistration were written.
